format: NDCA events, officials who may not compete

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Owners, organizers, chairmen of judges, adjudicators, MCs, scrutineers, music directors and demonstrators may not compete in any competition at an NDCA event.

requirement: Event-wide role-conflict check: an official whose account matches a competitor in the event is blocked at assignment and before ballot acceptance (NDCA-declared events).
interpretation_notes: Today no check relates an official to a competitor (audit J-09N). Identity matching covers accounts only. No exception is stated in the text read. Design only (PR-A): nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
decision_refs: OD-05 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option D BLOCK; retrospective audit PR #795)
